== History & Background ([[Dossier]]) ==
''[[Gankhaka (world)|Gankhaka]]'' officially has no government; in reality it is the site of several former Imperial era installations. Free lancers under the hire of [[Mynoris Corporation]] carry out excavations under the cover of prospecting operations. Several noble backers of the company do not want public notification of these operations to attract looters and competitors.
